belongs_to_collection.name: The Cross and the Crown Collection

data.overview: In the turbulent years after a civil war, two powerful families are bound together by affection, ambition, and old loyalties. When a captured commander returns home to a divided province, he gathers a secret brotherhood, drawing a nurse, her reform-minded father, and a rising political rival into a struggle that deepens the region's wounds.
data.tagline: A nation divided leaves no family untouched.
data.title: The Cross and the Crown
